description: This file defines a React functional component named VideoGrid which fetches, manages, and displays a paginated grid of videos. It handles different UI states such as loading, success, error, and empty states, and includes functionality for loading more videos.

methods.name: VideoGrid
methods.description: React component fetching and displaying a grid of videos with pagination, handling loading, error, and empty states.

methods.name: onLoadMore
methods.description: Function to load more videos when the user clicks the 'Load more' button, appending new videos to the existing list.
